issue.title: Preserve and bind South America batch 4 validator executions
issue.body:
Raised and independently verified 2026-10-07 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`.

Affected corrective PR #1120, merge `e7cd364e08a713825daa80a3d085d23bd58d5730`, head `5682cb8249e73de6360c6463c6ce79b51cc02de5`, closed #1116. Preserve the successful 215-subject baseline crosswalk correction and all original #935/#948/#1120 files. This is one additive erratum, not a reset of closed #1116 or ownership of #932/#933/#930 or separate #1330.

Independent checks establish that the original retained rows are correct: all15 whole added files (817136bytes), 30 whole manifest descriptors (16baseline/14output), eight metric bindings, the complete36-part index with49625 unique IDs, exact215 subjects and all39 original raw parent-child rosters. Raw unique complete indexed phase plus manifest inputs/outputs is214459504bytes, within256MiB. Two actual unchanged protected CLI executions reproduce all three retained products byte for byte: crosswalk-baseline-audit.json279165bytes/SHA256 `7308ac6134dc2cd00bd19432ffb5d97d4cc05757b8bf25a6d4d4f42f6c9bda1b`; positive-control.json339bytes/`c0d9243a5dedb7fe17934f5ceb42e33eeeee55dd680c8e1d131b6ecb3feabf94`; negative-controls.json3047bytes/`35a86c6a535676bcacdb7e4c7770e1928c800ce263f0b68c893d405331947187`. All9 existing negative controls reject. Only the final retained-root report write was redirected to private scratch; calculations and CLI arguments were unchanged.

Verified defects and reproductions:

1. The ordinary `verify-packet.py --out-dir NAME` unconditionally writes `legacy-false-positive-reproduction.json` in the retained packet root before producing the requested run. `write_json` uses ordinary mkdir/write_text and also overwrites existing requested run products. In an isolated owned review slot, create existing sentinel files at all three caller-selected audit-owned run destinations; redirect only the retained-root final write to a fourth audit-owned sentinel destination. Execute the unchanged actual CLI. It exits0 and overwrites all four sentinels. No original was used as a trigger destination. Merely selecting a fresh out-dir does not preserve the retained-root artifact. The neighboring `build-manifest.py` also writes the existing manifest through ordinary write_text (inspected, not executed). Expected: admit an entire exclusively fresh owned vintage before calculation, never rewrite retained evidence, and publish a completion receipt last.

2. `baseline_inputs` checks original reproduce.py SHA256 `f077ca8ab415b812e9832eb0340037313314be76947575b2ea6bfbafa56f2d0b` from immutable Git, but `legacy_false_positive` executes the materialized working-tree script with runpy.run_path. It does not bind that executed code or its materialized scope/part/source-register reads to the captured immutable bytes. A complete virtual code fixture at that actual runpy boundary prepends `AUDITOR_CODE_FIXTURE_EXECUTED = True` and replaces the single exact token `'baseline_matches':len(found)` with `'baseline_matches':len(found)-1`. Whole executed fixture SHA256 `1f36cfce1dd0cbec3bf96104598f4457ae3696c07f23959d8a709e357e2e8e31`; original file and all issue pins remain unchanged. The unchanged outer CLI exits0, executes the altered code, passes all9 author controls and stores legacy_output.baseline_matches214 alongside its independently derived baseline_feature_matches215. Actual resulting whole crosswalk audit SHA256 `3a355afa968f88be723f15c1ffd89a0ad34ba2d26eaec51bfc5afc03bb70195a`; legacy report `921efe97a6489cc8703741532cf259632b7a13e376c003f56dda1386f094785c`. There is also an actual vintage difference: the helper reads the merged working-tree source-register.json (10930bytes/SHA256 `1e124f1c15ce6b9396ffd97e2d791b2d7cc995eb7d134f2d6dcfed1f18f235ca`), while the new verifier separately checks the original935 Git register `24d34c91f5e3517d1a05e29f1733cc4c0a656422f54ea71a855f63de95f9f57a`. These are distinct legitimate historical vintages, not interchangeable consumed bytes; no incorrect current source content is inferred. Expected: execute captured authenticated original code and inputs, or reject actual execution dependency drift. This is cooperative provenance, not a security sandbox; no incorrect original source/data is asserted.

3. `audit(raw,ids,issue)` verifies parent row IDs/names/counts but ignores the original CSV's `scoped_location_ids`. Independently supply a complete controlled CSV to that actual unmodified function, changing only the first row's first semicolon-separated child to `gb:CHL:ADM3:AUDITOR-FABRICATED-CHILD`, preserving count, every other field and all other raw inputs. Candidate whole SHA256 `393b2345918184721eee9d436f692c8333f2bc561bfd9bfa857cbb05d5c8dff4`; original `26fa50de3fa6515fface069755f89b13dc6cb674b41fb95d9abcb9fbd0f91c2f`. It accepts and reports parent_review_rows_checked39/distinct_actual_parent_count39. This is a function-level semantic rejection gap, not a claim that an ordinary CLI can mutate authenticated Git history or that original rosters are wrong. Bind raw unique exact child tokens and all consequential parent fields to independently derived identities, rather than certifying rows solely from totals.

Bounded success criteria:
- Add a validator/reproduction/erratum only in the new owned prefix. Preserve every original file, successful mapping correction, source hash, ID, geometry/hierarchy, dated result and review/closure history. Exactly215 original subjects (167CHL,47PRY,oneAsunción aggregate),39parents/fiveareas; no separate263-subject #1330 expansion.
- Bind and consume actual whole immutable scope, issue snapshots, source/parent/crosswalk records and every executed project helper/import. Exercise meaningful complete code/input drift at the real execution boundary; reject before outputs or demonstrably execute captured original bytes. Preserve actual byte/runtime/code/metric receipts and inspect adjacent wrapper/legacy producer paths.
- Independently validate raw parent and child uniqueness, exact membership, names/links/counts and applicable partial/full flags against authoritative pinned records. Reject missing/fabricated/substituted/duplicate/blank children and incoherent rows even with refreshed candidate descriptors. Retain the existing nine real mapping controls and add independent adverse cases for these failures.
- Use current shared NewVintage/publication helpers or an explicitly reviewed equivalent. Two caller-selected fresh whole-run reproductions must preserve whole output hashes and truthful metadata differences. Existing ordinary files, broken symlinks, traversal/escaped destinations and post-calculation failure must reject safely: admission failure creates nothing, originals stay unchanged and partial runs have no valid completion receipt. Do not call an unsafe standalone original writer as a hidden step; do not regenerate the retained manifest.
- Respect32MiB ordinary/decoded file and256MiB entire phase bounds including the complete indexed inventory. Obtain substantive distinct exact-head review of the actual failed invariants; green CI/hash agreement is supporting evidence only.

Limits: no upstream geoBoundaries rows or INE response bytes were reverified. Current official INE/SUBDERE/Cadastre source-page factual assertions are not independently authenticated by this GitHub-only audit; #1120 remains Incomplete for that source-content scope. The missing originals and current legal/geometry approval are separate from these executable defects and are not prerequisites for this strictly mechanical erratum. Preserve explicit unknowns and do not turn retained-baseline agreement into source/legal certification. Original #935 remains separately Incomplete. A later repair PR receives its own audit.

Deduplication: complete14-page all-state issue inventory (927non-PR issues), affected-packet history and all open owned-path declarations showed no matching remaining repair or ownership overlap. Closed #1116 repaired original source-member checks; closed #1124 concerns the distinct #948 area crosswalk; open #1330 has a separate263-subject Paraguay validator. #624 is the shared-tooling umbrella, not implementation ownership of this packet. Dependency #1116 is closed with its canonical claim inactive/live_workfalse; leave it and other workers unchanged.

Baseline pin paths below resolve at exact affected merge `e7cd364e08a713825daa80a3d085d23bd58d5730`. Record them in the new manifest baseline.pin_files, alongside actual containing parts from the complete world index. The current-merge original-source-register pin below intentionally binds the later materialized register; preserve the separate original935 register pin24d34 at baseline7245 and do not falsely equate those vintages.
